component 0: [["What are different kinds of plant diseases", "Different kinds of plant diseases include Bacterial leaf spots, Fungal leaf spots, Powdery mildew, Rusts, Viral diseases like Tomato Spotted Wilt Virus, and Necrotic ring spot virus. These diseases can cause damage to crops and affect their growth and yield. Some common symptoms of plant diseases include discoloration, wilting, lesions, and abnormal growth patterns."]]

[["What is Stewart\u2019s wilt disease", "Stewart's Wilt Disease is a bacterial infection that primarily affects sugar beets and spinaches. It is caused by the bacterium Leifsonia solanacearum subsp. solanacearum. This disease can lead to severe damage and even death of the affected plants, causing significant economic loss for farmers. The disease spreads through contaminated soil or water, making it challenging to control without proper management practices."]]
